scope: Four primary-paper rereads, including two outside the R10 ledger; no reproduced performance or novelty claim.

entries.name: DiffSparse
entries.operator_information_objective: Token feature reuse with a learned (step,layer,rate) cost matrix, offline DP allocation, input-dependent token ranking and multi-step perceptual distillation. The allocation matrix itself is fixed after training.
entries.transfer_limit: Wan evaluation is20-step Wan2.1-1.3B; four-step appendix uses FLUX.1-schnell. Neither establishes14B dual-expert native HiF4 or our per-axis quality/FFN cost contract. Four-step cross-expert cache pairing/cold-start obstruction remains.
entries.resource_caution: Section4.1 says4-10 elapsed hours on8 MI250 devices; A.5.5 calls4-10 GPU-hours. Keep this denominator inconsistency explicit rather than promising the same cost on two A100s.
entries.consequence: Compare against strongest learned fixed allocation and count real token selection/transport; do not call another DP schedule input-conditioned layer allocation.

entries.name: Elastic Diffusion Transformer
entries.operator_information_objective: A router consumes modulated input latents, pools per-token projected features, predicts sample-dependent block skipping and quarter/half/three-quarter/full MLP widths; end-to-end flow matching plus average gate/width losses; inference slices actual matrices.
entries.transfer_limit: Average width penalties are not an exact hard per-video paired budget. Training and inference do not prove frozen Wan HiF4 native equivalence or cheap calibration.
entries.consequence: Input-conditioned width routing is already prior art. R12 must demonstrate an actual quantized action/value mechanism and post-training deployment, not claim novelty for the router.

entries.name: Dynamic Diffusion Transformer
entries.operator_information_objective: Time-dependent width masks can be precomputed; token bypass uses pre-MLP inputs and real gather/scatter, trained jointly. Sample-conditioned spatial selection is distinct from timestep-only width.
entries.transfer_limit: No inference from image DiT training to exact native four-step Wan/HiF4. Token gathering, output placement and complete cost need our own measurements.
entries.consequence: Separate conditional granularity from support count. A spatial seed needs actual mixed-action native propagation and a matched fixed spatial control; a hindsight output mosaic supplies neither.

entries.name: Dynamic sparsity in tree-structured feed-forward layers at scale
entries.operator_information_objective: Hard tree traversal integrates routing with node computation; training can collapse input-dependent paths into permanent sparsity. Moving the nonlinearity changes this behavior.
entries.transfer_limit: Changes the FFN function/weights and uses language-model training or fine-tuning; not a demonstrated cheap conversion of current frozen quantized Wan. Re-encoding/recovery inherits the R8 full-support precision concern.
entries.consequence: Measure whether learned conditional behavior beats a pruned fixed path; a nonconstant router or high sparsity percentage alone does not establish conditional value.
